name: Sanctuary Block
description: Adds a standalone Sanctuary Block: a configurable block that can protect an area from explosions, block placement, block breaking and mob spawns. Extracted and reimplemented as a lightweight, standalone version of the Sanctuary Block feature from 'Cobblemon: Legendary Monuments' by JorgaoMC (used under MPL 2.0). Original textures/model by SpookyThunder/AstraSilverhorn.
